wars.name: Battle of Chañar Viejo
wars.outcome: Ramírez was killed on 10 July 1821 near Villa de María de Río Seco and San Francisco del Chañar in Córdoba ('assassinated ... by forces loyal to his former ally López' on the Cepeda page); López Jordán succeeded him and the republic fell by October.

certainty.note: The page names provinces, not a boundary line; Misiones' relation to Ramírez after December 1820 is unclear.
